 SOXX: Don't Expect A Quick Recovery For AI Stocks
 Nov 01, 2026, 1:08 PM ET iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) 5 Comments Mauro Caversazzi 295 Followers Follow Summary
 I reaffirm my 'Sell' rating on the iShares Semiconductor ETF, citing a confirmed bearish trend and growth deceleration in semiconductors.
 SOXX has dropped nearly 28% from June highs, with technical signals indicating it could take over a year to recover.
 Intel's weak Q3 results and deteriorating guidance amplify sector-wide concerns about margin pressure and growth sustainability.
 I recommend rotating out of core semiconductor exposure and favoring assets less dependent on AI, such as energy infrastructure.
 Tippapatt/iStock via Getty Images
